rules.interaction: Federal or state criminal-history requirements that conflict with the policy preempt it.

applies_if.unavailable: housing provider receives DND funding or land, or the unit is an income-restricted unit under the BPDA Inclusionary Development Policy

rules.coverage_conditions: Housing providers receiving DND funding and/or land, or with BPDA Inclusionary Development Policy income-restricted units
rules.exemptions: Direct relationship between conviction and housing sought, unreasonable risk of substantial harm to others, current criminal behavior; conflicting federal or state law preempts
rules.title: Boston Fair Chance Tenant Selection Policy
rules.requirement: Housing providers with city funding or land, or inclusionary units, may not use a blanket ban on applicants with arrests or convictions and must decide case by case. They may not consider non-conviction arrests, judicially relieved convictions, juvenile records or convictions over 5 years old, and may not use credit scores to deny.
rules.key_value: no blanket criminal-history ban; ignore arrests without conviction, juvenile records, convictions over 5 years old
rules.citation: Boston DND Fair Chance Tenant Selection Policy (Feb. 2017)
rules.quoted_span: a) Arrests that did not result in conviction. This includes dismissed charges, diversion

notes: Policy applies only to DND-funded/land or BPDA inclusionary units, not data-derivable, so applies_if is an unavailable leaf. Effective date taken from the Feb 2017 page header; text gives no explicit effective date. Also contains credit-score ban, folded into one record.
